option_relations.rationale: The option describes epididymo-orchitis with abscess formation, which is a different condition from appendicitis of the testis.
The option describes hemorrhagic infarction of the testis, which is a different condition from appendicitis of the testis.
The option describes acute bacterial epididymo-orchitis with testicular infarction, which is a different condition from appendicitis of the testis.
The option describes acute epididymal orchitis with testicular infarction caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection, which is a different condition from appendicitis of the testis.
